teaser: The sign outside the corner shop flickers every night, unfixed, and you clock it without meaning to — that's the life path 3 in you, always gathering material. You are also an ISFJ, which means the noticing doesn't stop at material; it turns into a quiet tally of what needs doing. The 3 wants to make something of the flicker — a line, a joke, a story for the table. ISFJ wants to call the landlord and then forget the story ever happened. Both habits move through the same evening, and neither wins outright; what gets said aloud and what gets quietly handled live close together, trading places before you notice.
